title: Penalty not awarded: challenge by Thiaw on Marmoush
summary: Penalty not awarded: Challenge by Thiaw on Marmoush. Panel: The referee's call of no penalty was supported, 4:1. There was a genuine challenge for the ball by Thiaw with some contact made with Marmoush, but this was below the threshold for a penalty kick.
